description: A React component for a color input with a color picker, allowing users to input or select colors, with support for validation and focus management.

classes.name: ColorInput
classes.description: A React component providing a color input field with an integrated color picker, handling user interactions, validation, and state management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes refs and state based on props.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with incoming props when necessary.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Adds or removes event listeners based on the open state of the color picker.

methods.name: checkClick
methods.description: Handles click events outside the color picker to close it.

methods.name: togglePicker
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the color picker and focuses input when opening.

methods.name: handleColorChange
methods.description: Updates color state and calls onChange callback when a new color is selected.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles manual input changes, validates, and normalizes color input.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event on input, sets focus state and selects text.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Validates and updates color on input blur, resets if invalid.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Opens color picker on Enter or Space key press.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the color input, color square, and optional color picker modal.
